Treat this repetition as evidence about the memory→reconstruction→query process, not about either target. Without assuming an implementation, determine whether the current problem-formation machinery can admit that process-level residual. If admitted, devise a prospective comparator in which the existing lexical projection is frozen as baseline and a learner-authored semantic trace/crystal must improve a later query, retrieval, or problem-formation consequence on fresh returned data. Preserve source provenance and residual disagreement; WITHHOLD if the process-level residual cannot be lawfully formed or the candidate cannot beat baseline. Do not treat this mentor description as target-binding, evaluator return, truth, or promotion.
